name: PORTIER Agent HTML Generator (gesetz + local + hetzner)

parameters.command: cd {{$env.LOCAL_PROJECT_ROOT}} && docker compose -f docker-compose.prod.yml up -d opena20

set -euo pipefail
ROOT="{{$env.LOCAL_PROJECT_ROOT}}"
OUTDIR="$ROOT/19.opena20_dashboard_agent/static/generated"
mkdir -p "$OUTDIR"
TARGET="$OUTDIR/{{$json.agent_id}}.html"
printf %s "{{$json.html_b64}}" | base64 -d > "$TARGET"
echo "✅ Local saved: $TARGET"

set -euo pipefail
ROOT="{{$env.LOCAL_PROJECT_ROOT}}"
SRC="$ROOT/19.opena20_dashboard_agent/static/generated/"
DST="{{$env.HETZNER_PROJECT_ROOT}}/19.opena20_dashboard_agent/static/generated/"
HOST="{{$env.HETZNER_SSH_HOST}}"

# 1) sync generated dashboards
rsync -az --delete "$SRC" "$HOST:$DST"

# 2) ensure opena20 is up on hetzner
ssh "$HOST" "cd '{{$env.HETZNER_PROJECT_ROOT}}' && docker compose -f docker-compose.prod.yml up -d opena20"

# 3) smoke test
ssh "$HOST" "curl -fsS http://127.0.0.1:12349/health >/dev/null && echo '✅ Hetzner opena20 healthy (12349)'"
